title: Asian Group – Flood-Damaged Industrial Machinery Recovery & Recommissioning

date.notes: Owner identified this as the recent flood-recovery job. Supplied photo filenames span December 2025 to January 2026; the exact project start/end dates were not explicitly confirmed.

summary: A large-scale recovery, repair and servicing project carried out on multiple flood-affected industrial woodworking machines at the Asian Group of Companies factory in Kohilawatta. The work covered inspection, electrical and electronic troubleshooting, servicing, repair, component replacement and recommissioning across machine power and control systems. Equipment handled included edge-banding machines, CNC hole-cutting machines, automatic table saws and other production machinery. The recovery scope included VFDs, contactors, servo motors, induction motors, panel boards and associated electrical/electronic components.
problem: Multiple industrial woodworking machines and their electrical/electronic control systems were affected by flood water and moisture damage, requiring inspection, fault finding, repair, servicing and component replacement.
scope: Flood-damaged industrial machinery inspection and recovery
VFD servicing, repair and replacement where required
Contactor servicing and replacement where required
Electrical and electronic component servicing, repair and replacement
CNC hole-cutting machine repair and service
Automatic table saw repair and service
Repair and servicing of additional factory production machinery
equipment: Machine control PCBs and electronic modules
CNC and woodworking machine control hardware
outcome: A broad recovery and repair program was carried out across multiple flood-affected machines. Exact final status and replaced-part counts for each individual machine have not yet been documented in the archive.
evo_role: Industrial machinery repair, electrical/electronic troubleshooting, component servicing and replacement, and machine recovery/recommissioning work.

website.short_description: Large-scale repair and recovery of flood-affected industrial production machinery, covering VFDs, contactors, servo and induction motors, control panels, electronic components and machine-control systems across multiple woodworking machines.

photo_observations: One machine control PCB shows substantial corrosion/oxidation and rusted mounting hardware.
One industrial panel shows large contactors/protection equipment and visible corrosion or rusting near the cabinet base.
One machine control cabinet contains multiple YAKO-branded drive/control modules, industrial computer/control hardware, power supplies and extensive field wiring.
The visible condition of the photographed equipment is consistent with moisture/flood exposure, but the exact cause of each component failure cannot be established from photographs alone.
